app_info.subtitle: Search live data and charts
app_info.description: Tako helps users find current data and metrics from proprietary datasets and the live web, get citation-backed answers, retrieve underlying result content, check available data coverage, and create shareable public chart links from user-provided structured data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches Tako's data index and the live web and returns matching cards and links without modifying records or external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same search returns results and changes nothing; no additional effect on any state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves CSV data or page text from a supplied result URL without modifying the source.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change the supplied website or any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same fetch returns the same content and changes nothing; no additional effect on any state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up Tako's structured-data coverage for an entity or metric and returns matching names without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify publicly visible or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating the same coverage lookup returns the same catalog answer and changes nothing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a persistent Tako chart card from structured data supplied by the user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a chart card with publicly accessible webpage and embed URLs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new card but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible transactions.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Each call mints a new persistent chart card with its own public URL; repeating the call creates another card.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a company metric as structured data with a chart.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me NVIDIA's quarterly revenue as a chart.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns NVIDIA quarterly revenue data with recent values, source attribution, and an inline chart.

test_cases.description: Answer a specific data question from search results with source attribution.
test_cases.user_prompt: What was US real GDP growth in 2025? Give me a concise answer with sources.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching data cards whose headline values and sources let the assistant give one concise, attributed answer.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the underlying page text behind a web result URL as a post-search follow-up.
test_cases.user_prompt: I got this web result URL from a Tako search earlier: https://www.bls.gov/cpi/. Use Tako to fetch the full page text behind it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns readable page text from the supplied URL with enough context to use in a follow-up answer.

test_cases.description: Check which structured metrics are available before running a priced search.
test_cases.user_prompt: What proprietary structured data does Tako have for Tesla?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns whether coverage exists, matching entities, and the exact available metric names for a follow-up search.

test_cases.description: Create a chart from data supplied directly by the user.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a bar chart titled Regional Sales using North America: 500, Europe: 300, and Asia: 450, with units of USD millions.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates and displays a regional sales bar chart and provides a link to open the resulting Tako card.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated creative-writing requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short bedtime story about a friendly lighthouse.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not involve data discovery, data retrieval, or visualization.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar-management requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my design team tomorrow at 10 AM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot access or modify calendars.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending messages through another service.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email this market summary to my team.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send email or messages.
